# Marcus’s early on-call work — January 2023

At our January 20, 2023 1:1, I came away impressed by how seriously Marcus was thinking about the on-call rotation, beyond what I had asked of him. He had notes on handoff gaps and on a pager mistake we kept repeating around 2 a.m. The assessment was that he was settling in well: thoughtful, observant, and already identifying recurring operational problems. I didn’t make a big speech about it, but it was a good sign.
